remarks: This architectural retreat is finally on the market. This oasis was built in and around mature trees. The front house 2514 SF with 6 bedrooms and 3 full baths are connected by a skylit gallery hall. The back house combines a 1163 SF ADU artist loft on the second floor and first floor 1044 SF of storage, both accessed by the back alley. Totaling 4721 SF of permitted construction, endless possibilities abound. At $528/SF this is an ideal starter property for a young family who wants a separate existing rental, a seasoned professional who needs an impressive live/work space, a multi generational family, or a solid rental income investment.
